content: Yisakoore Zarkke
Yisakoores oyddu attuma nayti deettes; heytikka Tola, Puuwa, Yaashubenne Shimiroone geetettizayta.
Tola nayti Uuze, Erafaya, Yiri7eele, Yahimaye, Yibisaamenne Sameela; isttika Tola zarkketa halaqata; istti wolqqamanne mino olanchchata; kawo Dawite wode istta qooday 22,600.
Uuzey Yiziraaheya yelides; Yiziraaheyay Mika7eele yelides; Mika7eeley Abdiyu yelides; Abdiyuy Iyu7eele yelides; Iyu7eeley Yishiya yelides; ha ichchashatikka baso asatas halaqa.
Isttas daro machchetinne nayti diza gishshas isttaso asaa zarkketappe olas gakkida olanchchata qooday 36,000 gidides.
Yisakoore zarkketappe olas gakkida olanchchati mazgaban qoodettidi 87,000 gidida.
Biniyaame Zarkkenne Daane Zarkke
Biniyaames heedzdzu nayti deettes; isttika Beela, Bekerenne Yidi7eele.
Beela nayti Exiboone, Uuze, Uzi7eele, Yarmootenne Iire; ha ichchashatikka baso asatas halaqata; ba yeleta zarkketa mazgaban 22,034 wolqqamanne mino olanchchati mazgabettida.
Bekere nayti Zimira, Iyo7aasa, El7ezeere, Elyo7enaye, Omire, Yarmoote, Abiya, Anatootenne Alemeete; hayti ubbati Bekere nayta.
Istti ubbay baso asatas halaqata; ba yeleta zarkketa mazgaban 20,200 wolqqamanne mino olanchchati mazgabettida.
Yidi7eele nay Bilihaane; Bilihaane nayti Ya7uushe, Biniyaame, Ehuude, Kin7aane, Zettaane, Tarseesenne Akishahoore;
hayti ubbati Yidi7eele nayta; istti baso asatas halaqata; ba yeleta zarkketa mazgaban 17,200 wolqqamanne mino olanchchati mazgabettida.
Shufimeynne Huppiimey Ire zereththata; Hushimey Aheere zereththa.
Niftaaleme Nayta Zarkke
Niftaaleme nayti Yahixele, Gune, Yexirenne Shaloome; hayti Biliha zereththata.
Minaase Nayta Zarkke
Minaase zareti hayssafe kaalli xaafettidayta; Minaasey Aaraame biittafe ekkida garadeya yelida attuma nayti Asira7eelenne Gala7aade aawa Maakire.
Maakirey Huppimenne Shufime baggafe Ma7ikko machcho ekkides; iza michchey sunththika Ma7ikko geetettees; Maakire zare Xilofaadey macca nayta xalla yelides.
Maakire machcha Ma7ikay attuma nayta yeladus; bayra naaza Pareesha, iza kaaloza Shereeshe ga sunththadus. Pereesha nayti Ulaamenne Ereqeeme.
Ulaame nay Badaane; hayti Minaase naa Maakire naa Gala7aade zareta.
Gala7aade michchiya Hamoleketa Ishawu, Abi7eezerenne Mahile yeladus.
Shamida nayti Ahiyaane, Seekeeme, Liiqihanne An7aame.
Efreeme Nayta Zarkketa
Efreeme nay Shutula; Shutula nay Baareede; Baareede nay Tahaate; Tahaate nay El7aade; El7aade nay Tahaate;
Tahaate nay Zabaade; Zabaade nay Shutula. Efreeme naa Ezeereynne Elaadey mehe kaysana Geete dere biin he biitta asati istta wodhida.
Hessa gishshas istta aawa Efreemey daro wode kayottides; histtiin iza dabboti yiidi iza minththeththida.
Hessafe guye izi ba machcheyra gayttides; histtiin iza shaarada attuma naa yeladus; iza keeththan gakkida iita metoza gaason naaza Barihe gi sunththides.
Efreemes She7iro geetettiza macca nay dawus; izakka pude Beeti-Horoone, duge Beeti-Horoonenne Uuzen-She7ira geetettiza katamata essadus.
Efreemes Erfaha geetettiza hara attuma nay dees; Erfaha nay Eresheefa; Eresheefa nay Telaahe; Telaahe nay Tahaane;
Tahaane nay Laadaane; Laadaane nay Amihuude; Amihuude nay Elshama;
Elshama nay Nawe; Nawe nay Iyaaso.
Efreeme zareta duussasoynne istta biittay Beetele yuushon diza katamata, arshey mokkiza baggara Na7iraane, arshey wulliza baggara Gezeere, Seekeeme, Aayenne istta yuushon diza katamata.
Qasseka Minaase zareta biitta zawan Beeti-Sha7aane, Ta7inaake, Magiddo, Doorenne istta yuushon diza katamata; Isra7eele naa Yooseefe zareti ha katamatan de7ida.
Aaseere Nayta Zarkke
Aaseere nayti Yimine, Yishiwe, Yishiwanne Barihe; istta michcha Seraho geetettawus.
Barihe nayti Heeberenne Birizawaate aawa Malkki7eele.
Heebere nayti Yaafaleexe, Shomerenne Hoottamo; istta michcha Shuu7o geetettawus.
Yaafaleexe nayti Paasaake, Bimihaalenne Ashiwaate; hayti Yaafaleexe nayta.
Yaafaleexe isha Shemere nayti Ahi, Erohiiga, Yahuubenne Aaraame.
Iza isha Hoottamo nayti Xofaaha, Yimine, Sheleeshenne Amale.
Xofaaha nayti Suuha, Harnefere, Shu7aale, Beere, Yimire,
Bexere, Hooda, Shaama, Shilashe, Yitiraanenne Ba7eera.
Yootore nayti Yoofine, Pispanne Aare.
Uule nayti Arahe, Han7eelenne Erixiya.
Hayti ubbay Aaseere zareta; istti baso asatas halaqata; ba yeleta zarkketa mazgaban 26,000 wolqqamanne mino olanchchati mazgabettida.
